text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think you'd treat me to sweets as 
a reward, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's a limited-edition item, so 
we must go before it runs out!

Mejiro McQueen was able to achieve 
splendid results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years."

However—it just finished, so honestly, I 
haven't had time to savor the moment yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, two "Berry-Loaded Afternoon 
Tea Sets," please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If it's like the photo, it'll have three 
whole tiers packed with colorful 
sweets...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, just imagining it gets me excited♪
choice_data_list:
You were holding back before the race, 
huh.

You were holding back before the race, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Must you mention that right now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just when we've finally been released from 
tension and are relaxing, no less...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“Still, come to think of it, it was sweets 
that brought Trainer-san and me together 
in the first place.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I didn't have to give up on 
sweets or racing and was able to achieve 
my goal, after all.
choice_data_list: So it's all thanks to me, then?
So it's all thanks to me, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, aren't we acting quite 
presumptuous?

text_block_list.name: Male Customer
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, it's starting! The 'Hottest Umamusume 
Right Now' special feature!

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
You really love that, don't you? You're 
always checking it.

text_block_list.name: Male Customer
text_block_list.text:
It's seriously hot right now! I mean, just 
the other day at the autumn Tenno Sho—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh... The autumn 'Tenno Sho'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wonder if they are streaming a show?

Running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn), and 
broadcasting the program. Hearing that 
brings back a certain memory.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san, hello!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day. Come to think of it, today 
was an interview day, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I have a few questions, would you mind 
answering them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Please, feel free to ask 
me anything.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
First of all, congratulations on winning 
both the spring and autumn Tenno Sho 
back-to-back.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I imagine you'd like to take a breather 
here, but what would you like to do first?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. First, we shall enjoy some sweets 
to our heart's content—... Gah?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Huh, sweets?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you're mistaken! That's not it at 
all! Um... this is training!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Are you training?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to aim even higher even after 
achieving your goal... That's Ms. McQueen 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...! I'm sorry, that just slipped 
out—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Even though their Twinkle Series has 
wrapped up, you still can't take your eyes 
off them!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Let's continue to keep our eyes on her as 
she continues to excel!"

text_block_list.name: Male Customer
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap... That's amazing, McQueen! 
They're saying you're gonna go even 
higher!

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text: Huh, really!? Let me see it too!

text_block_list.name: Male Customer
text_block_list.text:
Still, what's the point of getting any 
stronger~? It's honestly starting to get 
boring.

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true. After all, you'll definitely 
win whatever race it is.

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, being so strong that it gets 
boring... that's kinda cool, honestly~”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh—isn't that footage from back then?! How 
embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, 'so strong it's boring,' is 
that how they put it?"
choice_data_list: That's what they were saying about you
That's what they were saying about you

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. That's not something anyone would 
say unless they were absolutely certain of 
victory, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, however... wouldn't that mean Trainer 
would also be "bored" then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"After all, you are the Trainer of someone 
as 'boring' as me, aren't you?"
choice_data_list: You mean we're the ultimate partners?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look at you getting carried away 
already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Still, I do like the sound of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"A partner so overwhelmingly strong it's 
almost boring"...! Heheh!
